entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's not what I wanted and I'm not using it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Mark Sterling. The order number is... VF88761. Just process the return, I don't have all day.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, about 29 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I'm a VIP member, I bought it, I don't like it, and I want my money back. Your website says returns are allowed.

I understand your frustration, sir. It's just that our standard return policy can be time-sensitive for wearable electronics. After so long, we have to consider factors like hygiene and sanitation. For some items, it might be too late.

HYGIENE? Are you kidding me? It's a band that goes on a shoe! That is an unacceptable excuse. Your website says 90 days! I want a manager, now! This is ridiculous. I'll post this entire conversation online!

My apologies, sir. Please, let me not get ahead of myself. You are right to call me out. Allow me to put you on a brief hold while I review the exact policy for this specific product and confirm the details for your VIP account. I'll be right back.
Fine. But this better be quick.

Thank you for your patience, Mr. Sterling. I have double-checked, and you are absolutely correct. I sincerely apologize for my mistake. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor is fully covered by our 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe, so it is not too late at all. I can process this return for a full refund immediately.
See? That's what I've been saying. Unbelievable. Okay, just do it then.

Absolutely. I've just generated the pre-paid return label and sent it to the email on your account. And again, for the confusion and poor experience I provided, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account. We value your status as a VIP member, and this was not the service we aim to provide.
Oh. A fifty-dollar credit? Well... okay. That's... more like it. Thank you. I appreciate that.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, the refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's it. Just make sure that label is in my inbox.
It should be there now. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
